title: Mara and the Provision
author: Rosalind Kavanagh
blurb: Noor Thornbury, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
